title: How do I send invitations to participants?
intent: This article explains how a survey owner sends invitation emails to participants.
short_answer: Navigate to the Participants page, select or create a guest list, compose your invitation email using the template editor, select the recipients, and click Send Invitations. Each invited participant receives a unique link to access the survey.
prerequisites: ManageInvitations local privilege or survey ownership
A guest list must exist with contacts, users, or tokens
The SMTP server must be configured
procedure: Create or select a guest list
Compose the invitation email with subject and body
Click Send to dispatch the invitations
important_conditions: Each invitation generates a unique access link
Limit of 1 million tokens per guest list
Guest list must be saved before sending
troubleshooting: Guest list name required error: Enter a name before saving
Invitations not received: Check spam folders and email validity
Invalid email address: Remove invalid contacts before sending
